payload.productNameEn: White Fabric Shower Curtain, 240 GSM Weighted Waffle Shower Curtains, Polyester Curtain With Rust-Resistant Hooks, Machine Washable & Water Repellent, For Bathroom Showers, Bath Tubs, 72x72 In
payload.categoryName: Home, Garden & Furniture / Home Storage / Furniture
payload.description:
Thickness Upgrade: Made from thick 240 GSM fabric, this white fabric shower curtain offers excellent light filtering and privacy coverage. Water beads up and rolls off the surface. For better waterproofing, pair with a 100% waterproof liner

Elegant Design: Featuring a bright white color and waffle weave texture, this bath curtain adds a refined touch to your bathroom. The dense weave helps it stay smooth and drape well, offering both visual appeal and long-lasting form

Generous Size: Measuring 72 x 72 in (1829 x 1829 mm), this washable shower curtain fits most bathrooms and provides ample coverage. It helps keep water inside the shower area and can also be used as a closet or room divider

Easy Installation: This shower curtain comes with 12 stainless steel grommets and 12 open plastic hooks for tool-free setup. Quick to install or replace. Hooks are compatible with liners for added convenience
